_comment: Training-stability domain term/alias map for EXT-010 cross-vault candidate discovery (CAP-013). Canonical term -> aliases. Built from the actual content of batch 010 (master-ai '04 - Neural Networks/Training' files 07 Initialization Schemes + 08 Vanishing and Exploding Gradients, 2 files, 117 KUs — a deliberate 2-of-3 partial-folder scope; 06 Backpropagation is excluded as a distinct autodiff/BPTT domain) and batch 011 (ai-course '04.3 - Training Dynamics and Stability' files 01 Weight Initialization + 02 Weight Initialization Techniques + 03 The Vanishing and Exploding Gradient Problems, 3 files, 382 KUs; three deterministic single-file runs concatenated in fixed order; file 04 Hyperparameters remains reserved for a future optimization/tuning pair per the EXT-009 scope note). Every term and alias is verified to occur inside at least one in-scope KU excerpt by scripts/ext010_term_map.py after four probe rounds (scripts/ext010_term_probe{,2,3,4}.py; reports/extraction/ext010-term-map-verification.json). HEADING-ONLY and ABSENT vocabulary correctly EXCLUDED (EXT-004 rule; probe-verified missing from BOTH batches): 'BPTT', 'backpropagation through time', 'weight decay', 'weight tying', 'momentum', 'nesterov', 'gated', 'covariance', 'gradient checking', 'calculate_gain', 'reset_parameters', 'initialise', 'initialisation' (British spellings absent), 'co-adaptation', 'dropout', 'early stopping', 'regularization', 'data augmentation', 'label smoothing', 'covariate shift', 'Adam', 'AdamW', 'optimizer' (course-only word, excluded as anchor but present), 'dampen', 'die out', 'extinguish', 'wash out', 'embeddings' (plural), 'prenorm'/'postnorm' (hyphenless), 'interview'/'production' (heading-only in master-ai; headings are not KU-excerpt evidence), 'variance tracking' IS included (course-only, verified). BRIDGE aliases deliberately connect different surface forms of the same concept across vaults: 'dying ReLU' (ai-course) with 'dead neurons' (master-ai); 'LayerNorm' (master-ai) with 'layer normalization' (ai-course); 'zero initialization' (ai-course) with 'zero init' (master-ai); 'RNN' (master-ai) with 'RNNs'/'recurrent' (both); 'sequence' (ai-course) with 'sequential'/'long sequences'; 'batch normalization' (ai-course) with 'BatchNorm' (master-ai); 'He et al' (cross-vault) with 'Glorot and Bengio' (ai-course); 'hyperparameter' (ai-course) with 'hyperparameters' (cross-vault); 'derivation' (ai-course) with 'derive' (master-ai); 'diagnostic dashboard' (ai-course) with the diagnosis family; 'flat' (cross-vault) with 'plateau' (ai-course) and 'plateaus' (master-ai); 'shrink' (cross-vault) with 'attenuate' (ai-course) and 'decay' (master-ai). KNOWN SPURIOUS/SENSE-COLLISION SOURCES, recorded here so classification dismisses or adjudicates them with evidence: (1) 'attention' — master-ai uses it for the self-attention mechanism (the Transformer solution to vanishing through recurrence; attention saturation; QK scaling), while ai-course uses it ONCE as the English idiom 'careful attention to initialization' (KU-6320fbea895ec3cf) — the course idiom sense must NEVER count as mechanism evidence; (2) 'norm'/'norms' — gradient norm (both vaults, clipping/diagnosis), LayerNorm/RMSNorm/pre-norm (master-ai), batch norm (ai-course); the key is kept because the gradient-norm sense dominates both sides; (3) 'spikes' — both vaults use it for loss-curve spikes as an instability symptom (genuine cross-vault sense), while 'loss spikes' as an LLM-operations topic is master-ai-only and links out to '11 - Training/Optimization/05 - Loss Spikes and Stability'; (4) 'noise' — master-ai 'training noise' (pitfall: ignoring loss spikes) vs ai-course 'deafening noise (overflow)' analogy — both metaphorical, not the irreducible-noise or augmentation senses of EXT-009; (5) 'scale'/'scaling' — init scale (both), residual-stream scaling (master-ai), attention-score scaling (master-ai), gradient/update scale (both); (6) 'bias' — bias-parameter initialization (both), never the statistical-bias sense of the generalization domain; (7) 'decay' (master-ai alias of 'shrink') — gradient shrinkage through depth, NOT weight decay (which is absent from both batches); (8) 'zeros'/'ones' — constant-initialization tensors (both vaults), context distinguishes from zero-gradient statements. EXCLUDED weak/generic anchors (probe-verified present but deliberately not included because they generate noise without discriminating power, documented per the EXT-009 rule): 'mean', 'expected', 'E[' (math notation), 'information', 'input'/'output' ARE included but 'matrix' alone is folded into 'weight matrix', 'sqrt', 'mathbf', 'frac', 'partial', 'mathcal', 'cdot', 'sigma' (bare LaTeX fragments), 'critical', '2010', '2015' (dating anchors covered by Xavier/Kaiming/'He et al'/'Glorot and Bengio' keys), '6' (sqrt(6) appears only inside LaTeX \sqrt{6} constructs). Keys starting with _ are documentation and ignored by the loader.
